remarks: Modern ranch perfection in one of Darien's most sought after neighborhoods. This exceptional home was stripped down to the studs and completely rebuilt, offering the rare combination of one-level living with the style and confidence of a near-new construction renovation. Thoughtfully re-imagined with clean and modern finishes and an easy, open flow, this home is designed for today's lifestyle- comfortable, clean-lined and turn-key. Outside the property has undergone a dramatic transformation. Dozens of trees were removed and extensive work on the drainage was conducted. New landscaping was installed to create an epic, expansive yard- ideal for entertaining, play, pets and future outdoor living enhances.  A detached garage offers additional bonus space ready to be transformed to an office, gym, studio, playroom. This location is unbeatable- right near Darien High School, trains and shopping!
